claim_boundary: A primary pass supports transfer of a gauge-fixed raw-variable coordinate exponent learned from UIUC dynamic propeller data to an independent TU Delft physical wind-tunnel dataset. A strong pass additionally supports wind-tunnel-to-flight transfer. It does not establish unique absolute dimensional coordinates, discovery from truly raw UIUC sensors, exact Reynolds-number physics, arbitrary-domain scientific discovery, or general AI.

external_source.paper_context: TU Delft wind-tunnel and independent flight data used for airspeed estimation from propeller feedback

selection.note: The last criterion is implemented as raw airspeed > 0.20*(RPM/60)*D and is only a fixed validity-domain filter mirroring the source authors; J is not passed to coordinate evaluation.

wt_evaluation.collapse_metric: pairwise CP curve interpolation NRMSE across deterministic equal-count RPM-rank bins
wt_evaluation.bin_cv_metric: leave-one-RPM-rank-bin-out CP prediction NRMSE with same degree-5 model for corrected and canonical coordinates

cross_modality.support_rule: score only flight points lying inside both WT-trained coordinate supports
cross_modality.fit_rule: fit CP(z) on all valid WT points, no flight calibration
